body.description: Manuscripts of the Warlord: The legacy of the Skeleton Warlord, once a stalwart defender who watched his king succumb to darkness. Now bound as a spectral guardian, he eternally protects and commands the secrets and lingering spirits within the castle’s forsaken walls—a testament to loyalty and the corrosive power of sinister magic.
